recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Future work should only modify RiskAssessment.encounter if a new work group decision changes its semantics; FHIR-7868 itself is already represented in current source.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive CDS change request from the 2015May cycle asking to add optional RiskAssessment.encounter as the encounter where the assessment was performed.
initial_application: Historical commit 40d7256c822f1a60dd4e540ecc5608f835dceeae explicitly applied #7868 by adding RiskAssessment.encounter as 0..1 Reference(Encounter) and adding encounter search parameter material to the then-authoritative RiskAssessment spreadsheet source.
additional_context: RiskAssessment is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini. FHIR-10361 later renamed the element to context during workflow alignment, and FHIR-19518 later changed the CDS workflow context back to encounter restricted to Reference(Encounter). Current source reflects that later final workflow decision. Community searches found no FHIR-7868-specific contradiction, and an R4 closeout Zulip thread recorded approval of the RiskAssessment encounter context change family.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The current authoritative StructureDefinition defines RiskAssessment.encounter as optional Reference(Encounter), the search parameter source includes RiskAssessment-encounter with expression RiskAssessment.encounter, and current examples include Encounter/example references.

related_jiras.note: Workflow alignment renamed RiskAssessment.encounter to context after the original FHIR-7868 addition, explaining historical churn.
Later published CDS workflow issue changed the element back to encounter and restricted it to Reference(Encounter), matching current source.
